title: Contract Coach
tagline: Reviews NDAs against our playbook in about a minute, so attorneys start from a marked-up draft.
problem: First-pass NDA review takes 30-45 minutes and mostly checks the same dozen clauses. Turnaround slows deals, and junior reviewers miss off-standard terms.
what: Compares every clause with the commercial playbook
Flags off-standard terms with the playbook position
Answers follow-up questions about the agreement
impact: First pass in minutes instead of most of an hour
Attorneys spend their time on judgment calls
team: Team 4: A. Rivera, J. Chen, M. Okafor, S. Patel, L. Novak
